All the fastest trucks in town are ready for the Championship Race; when Crusher steals the trophy before the race even begins, it's up to Blaze and his friends to get it back in time.

Blaze and AJ babysit Baby Gherkin; when it's time for her nap, they tell her three epic bedtime stories about police, cowboys and superheroes: all starring Blaze and his friends.
When Crusher accidentally knocks a bottle onto a meatball, it grows to an enormous size and rolls away; Blaze and Pickle transform into robots to stop the meatball before it wrecks the entire town.
